```{r setup, message=FALSE}
# Load all required libraries in one call, install if missing
pacman::p_load(
  tidyverse,  # dplyr, ggplot2, tibble, etc.
  Matrix,     # sparseMatrix
  caret,      # createDataPartition, confusionMatrix
  glmnet,     # glmnet, cv.glmnet
  pROC       # ROC, AUC
)
```

## Data Preparation

```{r data-read}
# Read diagnoses containing ICD events per hospital stay
diagnoses <- read.csv("mimic-iv-1.0/diagnoses_icd.csv")

# Read admissions and keep relevant columns
admissions <- read.csv("mimic-iv-1.0/admissions.csv") %>%
  select(subject_id, hadm_id, admission_location)

# Read patient demographics (age, gender)
patients <- read.csv("mimic-iv-1.0/patients.csv")
```

```{r filter-data}
# Filter for adult female patients only
adult_female <- patients %>%
  filter(gender == "F", anchor_age > 18) %>%
  pull(subject_id)

# Filter for emergency room admissions
er_admissions <- admissions %>%
  filter(admission_location == "EMERGENCY ROOM") %>%
  pull(hadm_id)

# Subset diagnoses to adult females in ER
df <- diagnoses %>%
  filter(subject_id %in% adult_female,
         hadm_id    %in% er_admissions)
```

```{r define-codes}
# List ICD codes that indicate IPV-related symptoms
suspicious_icd <- c(
  'E9672','E9673','E9671','E9670','E9679',
  'V6111','99581','99585',
  'T7411XA','T7411XD','T7411XS',
  '99580','T7611','T7611XA','T7611XD','T7611XS',
  'Y070','Y0701','Y0702','Y0703','Y0704','Y079'
)
```

## Sparse Matrix Construction

```{r sparse-matrix}
# Map each unique hadm_id to a row index
hadm_index <- tibble(hadm_id = unique(df$hadm_id)) %>%
  mutate(hadm_idx = row_number())
# Map each ICD code to a column index
icd_index <- tibble(icd_code = unique(df$icd_code)) %>%
  mutate(icd_idx  = row_number())

# Join indices back to main data for sparse matrix creation
df_idx <- df %>%
  left_join(hadm_index, by = "hadm_id") %>%
  left_join(icd_index,  by = "icd_code")

# Build sparse matrix X_full: rows = admissions, cols = ICD codes
X_full <- sparseMatrix(
  i    = df_idx$hadm_idx,
  j    = df_idx$icd_idx,
  x    = 1, #assigns a value of 1 to every (i, j) pair, indicating presence of that ICD code for that admission.
  dims = c(max(df_idx$hadm_idx), max(df_idx$icd_idx)) #sets the matrix size
)
# Label columns with actual ICD codes for interpretability
colnames(X_full) <- icd_index$icd_code

# Display dimensions: should be (# stays) x (# codes)
cat("X_full dims:", dim(X_full), "\n")
```

## Label Creation

```{r label-creation}
# Initialize weight vector for codes
mask <- rep(0, ncol(X_full))
# Identify indices of suspicious ICDs
sus_idx <- icd_index %>%
  filter(icd_code %in% suspicious_icd) %>%
  pull(icd_idx)
# Assign weight=1 to those codes
mask[sus_idx] <- 1

# Compute symptom score per stay: dot product
scores <- X_full %*% mask
# Binary label: 1 if any suspicious symptom, else 0
y <- factor(as.integer(scores > 0), levels = c(0,1))
# Check distribution
table(y)
```

## Feature Selection & Sampling

```{r feature-sample}
# Exclude code columns used for label creation
feature_cols <- setdiff(seq_len(ncol(X_full)), sus_idx)
X <- X_full[, feature_cols]

# Balance dataset: 1:3 ratio of cases to controls
cases <- which(y == "1")
controls <- which(y == "0")
set.seed(310)
sampled_ctrl <- sample(controls, length(cases) * 3)
sel <- c(cases, sampled_ctrl)
X <- X[sel, ]; y <- y[sel]

# Print matrix dimensions
cat("X has", nrow(X), "rows and", ncol(X), "columns\n")
# Print label vector length and class counts
cat("y has length", length(y), "\n")
print(table(y))
```

## Train/Test Split

```{r split}
# 80% train, 20% test split preserving class proportions
set.seed(310)
train_idx <- createDataPartition(y, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
X_train <- X[train_idx, ]; y_train <- y[train_idx]
X_test  <- X[-train_idx,]; y_test  <- y[-train_idx]
dim(X_train)
dim(X_test)
```

## 1. Logistic Regression (No Penalty)

```{r logistic}
# Fit logistic regression by setting lambda=0 in glmnet
model_log <- glmnet(
  x      = X_train,
  y      = y_train,
  family = "binomial",
  alpha  = 0, # 0, ridge, 1, lasso
  lambda = 0 # no penalty
)
# Predict probabilities on train and test
prob_tr <- predict(model_log, newx = X_train, type = "response")[,1] #return predicted probabilities rather than raw scores or class labels
prob_te <- predict(model_log, newx = X_test,  type = "response")[,1]
# Use mean training probability as cutoff
cutoff <- mean(prob_tr)
# Convert to factor labels for confusionMatrix
pred_tr <- factor(ifelse(prob_tr >= cutoff, "1","0"), levels=c("0","1")) #explicitly sets the class label order so that "0" is the reference
pred_te <- factor(ifelse(prob_te >= cutoff, "1","0"), levels=c("0","1"))
# Compute confusion matrices and AUC
cm_tr <- confusionMatrix(pred_tr, y_train, positive="1")
cm_te <- confusionMatrix(pred_te, y_test,  positive="1")
auc_tr <- roc(y_train, prob_tr)$auc
auc_te <- roc(y_test,  prob_te)$auc
# Display results
print(cm_tr); cat("Train AUC:", round(auc_tr,4), "\n")
print(cm_te); cat("Test AUC:",  round(auc_te,4), "\n")
```

## 2. Lasso Regression (L1 Penalty)

```{r lasso}
# 10-fold CV to select best lambda for lasso
cv_lasso <- cv.glmnet( # default lambda_min is 0.0001 if n_samples >= n_features, or 0.01 if n_samples < n_features
  x      = X_train,
  y      = y_train,
  family = "binomial",
  alpha  = 1,
  nfolds = 10
)
# Fit final model at optimal lambda
model_lasso <- glmnet(
  x      = X_train,
  y      = y_train,
  family = "binomial",
  alpha  = 1, # lasso
  lambda = cv_lasso$lambda.min #cv_ridge$lambda.min: the lambda value that gave the lowest cross-validation error
)
# Predict & evaluate (same steps as logistic)
prob_tr_l <- predict(model_lasso, newx=X_train, type="response")[,1]
prob_te_l <- predict(model_lasso, newx=X_test,  type="response")[,1]
cutoff_l <- mean(prob_tr_l)
pred_tr_l <- factor(ifelse(prob_tr_l>=cutoff_l,"1","0"),levels=c("0","1"))
pred_te_l <- factor(ifelse(prob_te_l>=cutoff_l,"1","0"),levels=c("0","1"))
cm_tr_l <- confusionMatrix(pred_tr_l, y_train, positive="1")
cm_te_l <- confusionMatrix(pred_te_l, y_test,  positive="1")
auc_tr_l <- roc(y_train, prob_tr_l)$auc
auc_te_l <- roc(y_test,  prob_te_l)$auc
print(cm_tr_l); cat("Lasso Train AUC:", round(auc_tr_l,4), "\n")
print(cm_te_l); cat("Lasso Test AUC:",  round(auc_te_l,4), "\n")
```

## 3. Ridge Regression (L2 Penalty)

```{r ridge}
# 10-fold CV for ridge penalty
cv_ridge <- cv.glmnet(
  x      = X_train,
  y      = y_train,
  family = "binomial",
  alpha  = 0,
  nfolds = 10
)
# Final ridge model
model_ridge <- glmnet(
  x      = X_train,
  y      = y_train,
  family = "binomial",
  alpha  = 0,
  lambda = cv_ridge$lambda.min
)
# Predict & evaluate as above
prob_tr_r <- predict(model_ridge, newx=X_train, type="response")[,1]
prob_te_r <- predict(model_ridge, newx=X_test,  type="response")[,1]
cutoff_r <- mean(prob_tr_r)
pred_tr_r <- factor(ifelse(prob_tr_r>=cutoff_r,"1","0"),levels=c("0","1"))
pred_te_r <- factor(ifelse(prob_te_r>=cutoff_r,"1","0"),levels=c("0","1"))
cm_tr_r <- confusionMatrix(pred_tr_r, y_train, positive="1")
cm_te_r <- confusionMatrix(pred_te_r, y_test,  positive="1")
auc_tr_r <- roc(y_train, prob_tr_r)$auc
auc_te_r <- roc(y_test,  prob_te_r)$auc
print(cm_tr_r); cat("Ridge Train AUC:", round(auc_tr_r,4), "\n")
print(cm_te_r); cat("Ridge Test AUC:",  round(auc_te_r,4), "\n")
```
## 3. ROC: Logistic vs Lasso vs Ridge

```{r plot-roc-fixed, message=FALSE}
library(pROC)

#Ensure each is a pure numeric vector:
prob_log   <- as.vector(prob_te)
prob_lasso <- as.vector(prob_te_l)
prob_ridge <- as.vector(prob_te_r)

#Build ROC objects
roc_log   <- roc(response = y_test, predictor = prob_log)
roc_lasso <- roc(response = y_test, predictor = prob_lasso)
roc_ridge <- roc(response = y_test, predictor = prob_ridge)

# construct FPR and TPR for ROC curve
roc_df <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    model = "Logistic",
    fpr   = 1 - roc_log$specificities,
    tpr   = roc_log$sensitivities
  ),
  tibble(
    model = "Lasso",
    fpr   = 1 - roc_lasso$specificities,
    tpr   = roc_lasso$sensitivities
  ),
  tibble(
    model = "Ridge",
    fpr   = 1 - roc_ridge$specificities,
    tpr   = roc_ridge$sensitivities
  )
)

# plot ROCs
ggplot(roc_df, aes(x = fpr, y = tpr, color = model)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "ROC: Logistic vs Lasso vs Ridge",
    x     = "1 - Specificity",
    y     = "Sensitivity",
    color = "Model"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,1), breaks = seq(0,1,0.1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1), breaks = seq(0,1,0.1)) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal() +
  annotate(
    "text", x = 0.6, y = 0.2, hjust = 0,
    label = paste0(
      "Logistic AUC=", round(auc(roc_log),3), "\n",
      "Lasso    AUC=", round(auc(roc_lasso),3), "\n",
      "Ridge    AUC=", round(auc(roc_ridge),3)
    )
  )
```

## Explainability: Top 10 Ridge Features

```{r explainability}
# Load ICD descriptions
icd_names <- read.csv("mimic-iv-1.0/d_icd_diagnoses.csv") %>%
  select(icd_code, long_title) %>%
  distinct(icd_code, .keep_all=TRUE)
# Extract coefficients from ridge model
coef_mat <- as.matrix(coef(model_ridge, s=cv_ridge$lambda.min)) #cv_ridge$lambda.min: the lambda value that gave the lowest cross-validation error
coef_df <- tibble(
  feature     = rownames(coef_mat)[-1],
  coefficient = as.numeric(coef_mat[-1,1])
)
# Join and pick top10
top10 <- coef_df %>%
  inner_join(icd_names, by=c("feature"="icd_code")) %>%
  mutate(label=paste0(feature,": ",long_title)) %>%
  slice_max(order_by=abs(coefficient), n=10)
# Plot
ggplot(top10, aes(x=reorder(label,coefficient), y=coefficient)) +
  geom_col() + coord_flip() +
  labs(title="Top 10 Ridge Features by Coefficient", x=NULL, y="Coef") +
  theme_minimal()
```
